-        // On 32bit systems we can also look through ConvL2I, since the final result will always

-        //

-        //   ConvI2L(ConvL2I(valL)) = ConvI2L(min_jint) = min_jint != max_jint + 1 = valL
-        //
-        NOT_LP64( case Op_ConvL2I: )
